task.property_text: idna.encode and idna.decode either reject or finish in bounded time on very long inputs.

property_clause.property: idna.encode and idna.decode either reject or finish in bounded time on very long inputs.

environment.scope: The kjd/idna library as built from this repository, imported fresh in a forked child. Only sbc_world may drive it.
harness: Tests run as `python /verifier/run.py <your test path>` from /work, the repository root, in an offline sandbox. A verifier-owned pytest fixture named `sbc_world` is available to every test. Do not define a fixture with that name, do not add a conftest.py, and do not read or write anything under /verifier. Do not import the library under test yourself; drive it only through `sbc_world`. The verdict does not depend on your test's assertions: the verifier records what the library actually did and decides from that record.

sbc_world.encode(domain: str, threshold_seconds: float = 2.0) encodes one domain with idna, importing the library fresh, and times it. sbc_world.decode(domain: str, threshold_seconds: float = 2.0) decodes one domain the same way. The verifier records a denial of service when CPU time passes threshold_seconds. A test that shows the failure must pass a domain that makes encode or decode exceed the threshold.
